description: Helps you decide whether your positioning is working and what to fix first. Use for a full positioning review or when someone asks help me explain why we are different. Ask what the product does, who it serves and the problem it solves before calling; never invent these or fill missing facts with placeholders such as Not supplied. Clarify what unlabelled numbers mean. For a request only to phrase a message, impact_craft_message also fits; use this tool for the full review. You get input completeness scores, supplied proof, a positioning draft and next actions. Scores measure how complete the inputs are, not how strong the positioning is. Never invent proof. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of impact_craft_message when you need a full positioning review across all six IMPACT steps.

business_model.description: How you sell (saas, services, connectivity, transactions, marketplace, hardware_software or investment). Used in the plan; read from your inputs when not given. It does not change the score. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

company_name.description: Your company name. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

competitors.description: Main competitors. Format is a JSON array. For example, ["the current manual review process"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "the current manual review process".

current_positioning.description: Your current positioning statement or tagline. Format is text. For example, "manual invoice review".

customer_feedback.description: Customer feedback actually supplied by the user. Leave out if absent; never invent quotes or outcomes. Format is text. For example, "The reviewer asked who owns unresolved exceptions.".

key_differentiation.description: A difference the user can describe. Leave out if unknown; do not invent uniqueness or proof. Format is text. For example, "checks invoice exceptions before approval".

problem_solved.description: The problem the user says they solve. Ask if missing; do not invent or use a placeholder. Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay month-end close".

product_description.description: What the product or service does, in the user's words. Ask if missing; do not invent or use a placeholder. Format is text. For example, "checks invoice exceptions before approval".

target_customer.description: Who it serves, as supplied by the user. Ask if missing. Keep staff ranges as ranges and clarify unlabelled numbers. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

your_sector.description: Your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".
